title: Exhibition advertising
slide_intent: Teach designers how changing the division between image and title affects the character of an exhibition advert.
strategic_value: Not Without My Ghosts can draw on the artwork as the recognizable subject while testing two voices for its title.
demonstration: Two versions pair the same artwork with different information fields. The upper layout splits black copy space and a wide image. The lower expands the pale copy field and uses a smaller image at right.
practical_value: Compare image area, title face and contrast together when choosing which version best introduces the exhibition.

content_islands.name: Dark-field treatment
content_islands.spec: Use a black text panel at left and a broad artwork crop at right. Give the white title a bold lead and place dates, tour credits and marks in supporting positions.

content_islands.name: Pale-field treatment
content_islands.spec: Use a wider pale text field and a narrower artwork crop. Give the dark title a contrasting type treatment while retaining the venue and supporting information.
